# Reproduction

Clean rerun by `src/reproduce_all.py` in `results_final/reproduction/tree` (a fresh copy of `src/` plus only the raw solve caches and the declared frozen inputs below), then every regenerated file compared with the committed one.

- Compared files: 46; identical: 42; equal within a relative tolerance of 1e-09: 2; **differing: 2** (`results_montecarlo/data/strips_info.json`, `results_montecarlo/data/strips_info_perturbation.csv`); missing in the rerun: 0.
- Monte Carlo seed: 20261027 (noise sets seeded per case and chunk; see ENVIRONMENT.md).

## Frozen inputs (copied, not regenerated)

- `results_priors_search/data/search.json`: input of strips_angle_info.py; written by the pre-symmetry priors_search.py run, whose structure pool has since grown, so it cannot be regenerated as committed (its numbers are retired)
- `results_corrected/data/sensitivity_db.json`: EMpy database of an earlier session (EMpy is not rerun); input of claims_checks.py
- `results_corrected/data/step_check.csv`: EMpy step check of an earlier session; input of claims_checks.py
- `results_femwell/data/sensitivity_db.json`: femwell database of an earlier session (femwell_postprocess.py also reads EMpy-era files); input of claims_checks.py
- `results_final/data/citations.json`: quotes extracted from the fetched PDFs, which are not in the repository (copyright)

## Random-sampling file: `results_montecarlo/data/strips_info.json` (seed 20261027)

The perturbation draws (default_rng(20261027)) perturb every strip derivative entry in the cache. strips_info.json was committed (3e828dd) before the strip TM index solves were added (6b84f2d), so the rerun draws more entries and the random sequence differs. Deterministic values reproduce exactly; the sampled statistics agree within sampling error (see max_abs_rel_diff).

| Statistic | Largest relative difference, committed vs rerun |
|---|---|
| nominal | 0 |
| median | 0.0332 |
| p05 | 0.0357 |
| p95 | 0.126 |
